## IAlternativesPresentationContext interface

The further fixes of one finding, listed as alternatives to consider. Nothing is applied; each only shows the changes it would make.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface IAlternativesPresentationContext extends IPresentationContext 
```
**Extends:** [IPresentationContext](./sarif-to-comment.ipresentationcontext.md)

## Remarks

`required` holds each alternative's `changes`<!-- -->.
